82523: Abandoned by his parents, Sora is a brilliant NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with his stepsister, Shiro. He does not take life very seriously and is pretty much a good-for-nothing gamer.
82525: Shiro is the main female protagonist. She's a genius NEET (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) hikikomori (shut-in) gamer along with her step-brother, Sora and together they formed 『 』.
82527: Stephanie is expressive and emotional, to the point where she cannot hide her emotions during a poker game. She loved her grandfather dearly and is angered when people call her grandfather a fool.
87887: Jibril is the youngest and strongest of the Flügel race. Her love toward knowledge starts even before the declaration of the Ten Oaths. She is against the book sharing law, and left her homeland to win the main library of the human world from the previous king in a game.
88001: A human who allied with several different races in order to win the king's contest, due to her belief that humans will never be strong and must depend on others in order to survive.
88002: Fiel Nilvalen who usually has her name shortened to Fii, is an Elf girl who is Chlammy Zell's game partner, as well as the one who helps her cheat using her elven magic. She is very protective of Chlammy and would go to great lengths to keep her safe.
88003: Izuna Hatsuse is a Werebeast girl and the former ambassador of the Werebeast race to Immanity. After Sora and Shiro forced the werebeasts to join the Commonwealth of Elkia, Izuna was directed by Miko to follow and learn from them.
88004: Tet is the One True God of Disboard. Tet does not belong to any of the 16 races, although the closest affiliation to him would be Immanity. To challenge Tet for the title of the One True God, one must collect all pieces of different chess from 16 races.
88267: The previous ruler of Imanity, as well as Steph's grandfather. His reign led to many losses for Imanity, thus many people call him a, "Foolish King." He is terrible at games, being unable to win a majority.
123690: Schwi was the first Ex-machina to be introduced in Tet's story. In the story she seeks to understand the human heart and was found by Riku.
123691: Riku was an 18 years old Imanity who lived during the Great War on Disboard. He was one of the main protagonists in Tet's story. He encountered Shuvi while going on an expedition and brought her to his colony after having lost in a game against her (albeit willingly).
123692: One of the colonists in Tet's story and the supposed older sister of Riku. She was also the founder of Elchea after the Great War and is Stephanie Dola's direct ancestor. Couronna has a very similar appearance to Stephanie Dola; however, her hair is slightly longer and darker.
123693: Nonna Zell was an Imanity that lived during the Great War. She is Chlammy Zell's ancestor. Nonna bears many similarities with Chlammy. She is quite short and fair-skinned, and has short, black hair and navy blue irises with pink pupils.
123694: Think Nirvalen was an Elf that lived during the Great War. She is Fiel Nirvalen's ancestor. She encountered Riku Dola after her invention of Void Zero Protection and its sister model, Eternal Fourth Protection. Think bears many similarities with Fiel.
126084: The first Flügel created by Artosh and Representative of the Council of Eighteen Wings. As such, her title allows her to have first say in emergencies. She calls Jibril her "little sister". During the war, she conveyed Artosh's will among other Flügel.
130376: Nonna's father. He was a member of the surviving humanity during the great war. During an exploration, the team encountered an unknown being. The leader of the group, Riku, ordered him to sacrifice himself to save the others.
134187: Queen is the in-game name of a character, who was not mentioned in the original light novel, who is said to be the strongest member of 『Night Opera』, a guild of 1,200 players. She appears in the first episode of the anime.
137440: Miko is the representative of the Werebeasts and rules over the Eastern Union. She lost her real name during the formation of the country when placing it as a wager.
137443: Einzig is the call sign of the current administrator unit of Ex-Machina, therefore making him the Representative of the cybernetic race. Much like Riku, Einzig acts like a cold, emotionless figure to accept the self-sacrifices of his brethren.
137444: Raphael is the fourth unit of Flügel, along with being a sister figure for Jibril. Raphael is calm, but is easily annoyed, often by Azriel. Due to a prior event, Raphael is missing most of her left wing.
139370: The God of War and creator of the Flügel. Artosh was considered to be the strongest and mightiest member of the Old Deus. He is described as being a hulk of a man, being over double the height of a regular man.
139371: A werebeast and Izuna's grandpa. He is protective of Izuna and dislikes it when she is close to Sora and Shiro. According to Miko, Hatsuse has thirty wives, much to Sora's chagrin. Hatsuse acts in a formal manner, being friendly around guests and officials.
145834: Nina Clive was an Elf that lived during The Great War. After Think faked her death, he assumed the title of Grand Magus in order to help accomplish her plans. As a penta-caster, he is capable of maintaining 5 spells at the same time.
